scope: Native prototype verification, not production integration
harnessCorrections: Editing an interaction while the preview was running invalidated the state being measured. Predicate hotspots are now installed before preview and removed after testing.
The F9 injection experiment did not navigate. Runtime predicates use real pointer clicks instead; this does not verify keyboard support.
Reading the verifier source as AST with the Windows default encoding produced a different dash literal. The source reader now explicitly uses UTF-8.

The disabled-control helper initially required the Primary disabled master. The transfer prerequisite correctly used the Secondary disabled master; the helper now accepts either disabled master and still requires no active interaction.

A mobile return/header click was not registered. Pointer leave and longer event spacing were added; financial writes are not blindly retried. Later checks stopped when the preview had null geometry and screenshots required a visible window.
checkpointPolicy: Passed desktop cases and passed mobile journeys were retained. The remaining mobile tail completed after restoring window availability.
cleanup: Temporary assertion hotspots are deleted and the receipt back action restored before saving. Final delivery inspection must contain zero __runtime_assert nodes.

windowAvailability.method: User confirmed the window was visible; asynchronous restore/raise of the existing FigCraft process restored preview geometry. No application process was killed.
windowAvailability.result: The mobile tail completed after window access returned.
